newsitem.title: JAPAN: Typhoon Opal halts flights, ferries in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Typhoon Opal halts flights, ferries in Japan.

text.p: Flood warnings were issued for the Japanese capital and scores of domestic flights and ferries were cancelled on Friday as typhoon Opal bore down on Japan's main island.

Opal, classified by Japan's Meteorological Agency as a medium-strength typhoon, landed in western Japan early on Friday morning and was expected to sweep through central and eastern Japan by evening, the agency said.
The typhoon is packing winds of up to 108 km (64 miles) per hour as it proceeds north-northeast from the Kii peninsula, near the western commercial city of Osaka, the agency said.
Opal is forecast to dump 20-25 cm (7.9-9.9 inches) of rainfall over a wide area of central and eastern Japan through Saturday morning, the agency said.

Japan's domestic carriers cancelled 37 domestic flights on Friday and most ferry services to outlying islands were halted, but no cancellations of international flights were reported, authorities said.
